item: The Ollama installer's asset download is held to GitHub's release hosts (github.com, release-assets.githubusercontent.com, objects.githubusercontent.com), and a refused address or redirect is its own 502
key_paths: src/llm/installer.py; src/api/llm.py; tests/test_session_host_list.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md; docs/ledger/RULINGS_INDEX.md
summary: Closes the asset half of R141. The release lookup and the download now share one helper, _get_within: GITHUB_API_HOSTS for the lookup and GITHUB_ASSET_HOSTS (the three GitHub hosts the consent popup lists for the Local AI lane, a test keeps them equal) for the download, each checked in GuardedSession.send on the first request and every hop. The address the release response names is pre-checked with refuse_unlisted_host, because requests rejects a malformed address before send with an error that quotes it; a non-text address is refused as a missing URL. A refusal raises InstallerRedirectRefused(download=True) with its own fixed sentence (DOWNLOAD_MESSAGE), raised outside the handler so it has no cause and no context, class name only in the log; /api/llm/install/prepare answers 502. UNLISTED_SESSIONS no longer holds the installer. The hosts come from this repository's own record, not a look at the live redirect (the build sandbox cannot reach GitHub), so the registry entry github-release-asset-hosts (12 months) says its date is when the record was written, and the queue entry keeps one operator step STILL OPEN: follow the real chain from a networked machine. The list limits where the request goes, not what is installed (github.com lets the response name any github.com path); the sha256 GitHub attests still refuses a different script. Tests: one refusal per clause (another host, a sibling, the bare domain, the lookup's host, a listed name as a prefix, plain http, credentials, another port, a percent sign), followed hops, malformed and non-text addresses, the whole check through the real redirect machinery, other failures not called refusals (404, ConnectionError, Timeout, TransportUnavailable, NetworkBlocked), the sink test at both stages, timeouts 30 and 120 with the egress window open, per-fetch stream isolation, and the list equal to the popup's. One independent read: 0 block, 2 should-fix (a malformed address leaked into a 500, unpinned helper arguments), 6 low, folded; every mutant the read found killed. R137, R139 and R140 rows are carried by their own threads, not here.
